headline: FMCAD paper reports SMT-based formal verification of SystemVerilog RNM
fact: TU Wien's repository made available an FMCAD 2026 paper by Augusto Mafra and Haniel Barbosa describing a formal-verification flow for SystemVerilog real-number models built by extending Yosys and Pono. The paper compares SMT model checking with real-arithmetic and IEEE floating-point interpretations on 31 mixed-signal benchmarks, documenting performance and semantic tradeoffs.

sources.title: Formal Verification of Mixed-Signal Systems Using Real Number Modeling with SMT-based Model Checking
sources.summary: The proceedings record identifies the authors, Yosys/Pono benchmark study, and Cadence Systems Verification Group and UFMG affiliations. It lists September 2026 publication and September 2 repository availability; the Event dates that availability, not a conference presentation. The reported flow is not identified as a Jasper product feature.
